assertion.text: Erdős Problem #488 [status: falsifiable; formalized: yes]. Let $A$ be a finite set and\[B=\{ n \geq 1 : a\mid n\textrm{ for some }a\in A\}.\]Is it true that, for every $m>n\geq \max(A)$,\[\frac{\lvert B\cap [1,m]\rvert }{m}< 2\frac{\lvert B\cap [1,n]\rvert}{n}?\] Current best: The constant $2$ would be the best possible here, as witnessed by taking $A=\{a\}$, $n=2a-1$, and $m=2a$. Prize: no. Tags: number theory.
